sections.title: B. Write questions in the passive.

items.q: When / the light bulb / invent? → ______
a: When was the light bulb invented

items.q: Where / tea / grow? → ______
How many languages / speak / in India? → ______
a: How many languages are spoken in India

items.q: Who / the Mona Lisa / paint / by? → ______
a: Who was the Mona Lisa painted by

items.q: Where / the first computer / build? → ______

sections.title: Listening. Listen to five people talking about a science project. What is each speaker's main aim?
sections.script:
One. The teacher.
This year I want my students to stop just reading about science. I want them to design something real that solves a problem at our school.
Two. The girl.
Our team is making a machine that sorts plastic bottles from paper. I really hope we win the competition, because the prize is a trip to a science museum in Moscow.
Three. The man.
I work for a recycling company. I'm here to find young engineers — maybe one of these students will work for us one day.
Four. The woman.
I'm a journalist. I'm writing an article about how schools teach science differently today, so I'm interviewing teachers and students.
Five. The boy.
Honestly, I just want to learn how to use the 3D printer. Winning doesn't matter to me — I want to make my own phone case!

items.q: 1. The teacher's main aim is to
o: help students solve a real problem.

items.q: 2. The girl's main aim is to
3. The man's main aim is to
4. The woman's main aim is to
5. The boy's main aim is to

sections.title: H. Read the forum posts. Which person (A–D) says each thing? One person matches two questions.
sections.passage:
A — Madina: I can’t live without my smartwatch. It counts my steps and reminds me to drink water. My grandmother thinks it’s silly!

B — Otabek: I think the best invention is the washing machine. Before it, people spent a whole day washing clothes by hand.

C — Zarina: Phones are useful, but I’m worried about how much time we spend on them. Last month I turned mine off every evening, and I slept much better.

D — Bekzod: My dream is to design robots that help old people at home. I’m studying engineering now, and I’ve already built a small robot that can carry a cup of tea.

items.q: Who wants to invent something?
Who chose an old invention as the most important?
Who changed a habit?
Whose relative doesn’t understand their gadget?
Who has already made something?
